title: First Look of FLAIR on mobile!
author: SneakerHunterDev
selftext:
Over the Last Week a started working on a mobile Version of Flair in Addition to the pc Version. Do You guys think this Game could be fun as pc + mobile crossplay? 

Looking forward to hear your Feedback

Here’s the Steam page if you want to check it out: https://theflairgame.com/on-steam?utm\_source=reddit&utm\_medium=social&utm\_campaign=mobilefirstlook&utm\_content=aigamedev

(A wishlist would genuinely help a lot, if you like the idea <3)

comments.author: Logical-Map5979
comments.body: Nothing about this game looks like it would be fun in any way, cross play is the least of its worries

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Okay, thank You for your honest Feedback

comments.author: -goldenboi69-
comments.body: What is the idea? Hard to tell from the screenshot.

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: You Can Check out the Trailer on the steam Page

replies.author: Yasstronaut
replies.body: You need to work on your elevator pitch then

replies.author: agarlington
replies.body: This was also my concern Felician! when I playtested the game was cool like mechanically and looked nice but there was no gameplay loop there yet.

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body: Yes! I did not forget about your Feedback ;) I already implemented a first Game Loop. There Are now Zone Games where You Can Fight and survive multiple Waves of AI generated Bots. Now I‘m Improving this Game Loop and I also have many ideas for quests which I will work on soon! Now I should think about showcasing this in a better Trailer!

replies.author: agarlington
replies.body: so happy to see your work my friend! looking forward to it

replies.author: SneakerHunterDev
replies.body:
Thank you for always giving me so helpful Feedback! This really motivates me and pushs me forward to the Next milestones! 
Also keep me posted on how your project is going! Thank you so much <3
